title: Nomic AI Inks 5K-SF Deal at 99 University Place Near Union Square
ai_summary: Four tenants signed office leases totaling 15,593 square feet at 99 University Place near Union Square. The leases, including Nomic AI, Therapeutic Alliance Suites, and T Moriarty & Son, carry an asking rent of $55 per square foot. The deals reflect demand for limited office supply in Greenwich Village.

title: Arcadis invests in AEC AI platform Nomic
ai_summary: Arcadis made an undisclosed strategic investment in Nomic, an AI-driven SaaS platform for AEC workflows, and signed a long-term commercial partnership. The partnership followed a six-month trial with 150 engineers across 12 countries, where 86% reported a change in work approach. Arcadis aims to embed Nomic's agents into existing toolchains and expand the platform to additional project teams.
